notes.title: v0.3.888 🙃🌿
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Mowmeowians! Er.. Meowzers? Uhhh..[/h3][p][i]*clears throat*[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Hey there.. you! ːTECsweatː ːpoemgː[/h3][p][/p][p]For the past few weeks I've failed to migrate fully over to mirror / steamworks and finally started to backtrack changes last week out of lack of patience (sign to meditate again? perhaps!). [/p][p]Now I come with an update - not the fun one with cosmetics, more furr, the level up system and more areas to explore, but an update that's needed.
[/p][list][*][p]Private lobbies are now a thang'[/p][/*][*][p]Hosts are now admins[/p][/*][*][p]Admins can now kick kitties out[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard controls shown with Momo added to main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Cat may still get tired of mowing, but they should pop back up on the next segment[/p][/*][*][p]Vivox chat filter enabled at all times (will change in future)[/p][/*][*][p]Lobbies disappear quicker now when the host closes it out (unless they quit the game)[/p][/*][*][p]Username automatically taken from Steam meow[/p][/*][*][p]When host turns into a client or vice versa, chat was broken… now it *should* be goooood[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could join a lobby with the wrong case, but still get in, but like, you couldn't talk bruh[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several errors that weren't game breaking but aren't important enough to mention here, except wait, I did mention them… ah damn it[/p][/*][*][p]Chat alert when someone leaves[/p][/*][*][p]And the most important one of all.. a welcome message when you start a lobby… How comforting![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If all goes according to plan, the next update is adding a…… level up system! You may be wondering - do I put points in DEX for speed or VIT for.. wait, you can't die in Mow Meow.. Hmm no no, leveling up will grant you new furr and access to new areas. Catnip will then be used to buy cosmetics or items, or other furr. The catnip acquired will get reset (if it didn't already happen for you on from this update), so sorry if you have millions (pft, no one has millions).[/p][p][/p][p]Hopefully the next update doesn't take as long as this one...[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience. ːluvː ːbbtcatː[/p][p]sorryaboutyourcats[/p]

notes.title: Cloud & the deck 🐈🌫☁💾
notes.content:
This patch is small... but had me going crazy!
[Mostly because I don't like people losing progress AND I had my Steamworks depots set up all sloppy.]

[h2]v0.1.888d notes
[/h2]

[list]
[*] Steam cloud support has been added!!!
[*] Catnip amount is now correctly saved on the Steam Deck

[/list]

If for whatever reason your catnip amount got reset, let me know and I will mail some catnip to you.
